title: trifolium alexandrinum var. berytheum
intro: Trifolium alexandrinum var. berytheum, commonly known as Palestinian clover or Jerusalem clover, is a subspecies of the clover plant. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium alexandrinum var. berytheum include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-bacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
